_week: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01 (Week 44). Written from that week's numbers.
week_story: Sales rose 25% to $1,845 on 25 orders (21 the week before) while ad spend fell 24% to $365.
Pro Cuff gloves grew 65% to $568 and the flavor Strap Cuff line doubled to $487; core Strap Cuff slipped 8% to $791.
refunds: Refunds were $150 on 3 units (12% of orders), down from $409 on 7 units (33%) the week before. Refund rates have run above 10% every month this year, so return reasons are still worth a look.
pacing_reco: November is off-season for batting gloves; last November did $24.8K and December $106.6K, so the job now is to get listings, stock and branded ads ready for holiday gifting.
ads_context: Ad spend fell to $365 from $482 while ad sales rose 51% to $1,055.
ACoS improved to 34.6% from 68.9% and TACoS to 19.8% from 32.7%.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords drove 11 of the ad orders: $76 spent for $785 in sales (9.7% ACoS).
Category keywords spent $110 for one $60 order, and auto targeting spent $99 for one $75 order.
bid_moves: Scale “jax batting gloves” exact (SP): $56.70 spent for $634.91 and 9 orders.
Pause or negate the Sponsored Brands “jax athletic” phrase target: $31.54, 74,034 impressions, 0.03% CTR, no sales.
Lower bids on “baseball batting gloves” and “batting gloves” phrase targets: $56 spent with no sales.
promotions: This week: 2 promotion orders, $20.25 in promotional discounts (vs $22.50 last week).
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
Deal and coupon set-up deadlines: to confirm with the account team.
Last year December was the biggest month ($106.6K); plan holiday gifting offers now.
reviews_body: Sellerise returned no review records, rating trend or negative reviews for JAX Athletics over the last 90 days.
That means the review tracker isn't pulling for this account, not that there were no reviews.
reviews_reco: Turn on review tracking for JAX Athletics in Sellerise so the deck can show star rating and review count per line.
With refunds above 10% most months, read the newest 1–3 star reviews to see whether sizing drives returns.
recommendations: Raise budget and bids on the branded “jax batting gloves” exact campaign (9 orders at 8.9% ACoS).
Pause the SB “jax athletic” phrase target and review the 20 campaigns that spent $86 with no sales.
Cut category phrase bids (“baseball batting gloves”, “batting gloves”); keep only exact terms that convert.
Shift spend toward Pro Cuff and the flavor Strap Cuff line, which grew 65% and 101%.
Plan BF/CM and December gifting deals; confirm deal and coupon deadlines.
Share the stock position per line so holiday ads don't send traffic to sizes that are out.
Turn on review tracking and review return reasons behind the refund rate.
position: October closed at $9.6K; November starts slow at $240 on day 1 (last year Nov 1: $898).

next_steps: Scale branded exact; trim no-sale category targets.
